message.content:
It’s exposed as the **`acl_api_AclApi_retrieve_projects`** function.  
To get the list of projects for a particular team you simply call that function and supply the team’s UUID:

```json
{
  "uuid": "YOUR_TEAM_UUID_HERE",
  "excludeInactive": true,   // optional – defaults to false
  "onlyRoot": false          // optional – defaults to false
}
```

When you invoke it, the service will return a JSON payload containing the projects that belong to that team, filtered according to the flags you set.  

If you’re looking for the actual HTTP endpoint, it’s typically something like:

```
GET /api/v1/teams/{team_uuid}/projects?exclude_inactive=true&only_root=false
```

(Your exact URL may vary depending on your deployment.)
